comment: Dr. Carpenter is an amazing professor, and I highly recommend taking a class with her. She is very accessible outside of class and genuinely invested in helping her students succeed. She has truly sparked my passion for biology.
One of my favorite professors here. Cares about all her students and wants you to succeed. Don't let the tough grader scare you she means well and is fair.

Dr. Carpenter was my favorite professor this semester. She truly wants every one of her students to succeed in any way possible. She is always willing to meet outside of class and is overall an amazing professor and person. She is a tough grader, but she just wants you to understand the material. She knows the material and is passionate about it.
Amazing professor!! She knows her stuff in and out. Very cool very approachable . Supports her students in every way .

Dr. Carpenter is AMAZING. She cares so much and genuinely wants you to do well. She is so funny and does great lectures, it is pretty lecture heavy but she tries to break every class up with one activity or table discussion. I could not recommend taking her enough, the class is difficult but theres not a better person to take it from.
Lectures were underwhelming and she often lectured too fast to take accurate notes. Overall not the most exciting class but not the worst.
This is for her drugs and genes course, BIOL342. Alright lecturer, great lab, tough grader especially in her exams, and get ready for like 8 assignments all due within the last 3 weeks of class.
The concepts for this class are pretty understandable, but the details are meticulous and easy to miss which can cost you on an exam. Making sure to not fall behind is also key.

Biology 200 is a tough course and requires quite a bit of work especially for the lab portion but Dr. Carpenter gave good practice and lectures to prepare you. I wasn't a huge fan of the Biology 200 curriculum but Dr. Carpenter certainly did a pretty good job of teaching it, especially as a first time teacher! I'd recommend taking her!
